capabilities: generate an animated GIF from a text prompt
save the GIF to a configurable vault folder
embed the GIF at the cursor as an Obsidian embed
extras: Each GIF costs 1 credit; new accounts get one free GIF with a small aigifmaker.ai badge, and failed generations refund the credit. The plugin claims no telemetry and sends data only to aigifmaker.ai endpoints.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to generate GIF images from a text description without leaving the note or using external tools and video conversion.

relations.evidence: This is the official Obsidian plugin for AI GIF Maker: put a GIF in your note without leaving it.

summary: AI GIF generator that turns a text prompt into an animated GIF saved to the vault and embedded at the cursor via the AI GIF Maker service.
